purpose: Discovery arm. Finds NYC-area companies showing office-demand signals and hands them to NormanAI-crm-core intake. Never writes Notion.

downstream.note: crm_intake.py is the ONLY Notion writer. Research emits CSV; intake dedups and creates.

crmCore.note: Research calls crm-core's REAL fit scorer via subprocess to predict how a candidate would score. Never reimplement the bands here — a drifting second copy is worse than no prediction.

gate.note: Prospect threshold is 60 in crm-core. We gate at 55 because research estimates NYC heads/jobs rather than measuring them, and the lanes routinely revise upward. Below this, a company would land at Needs Review and cost JD attention for nothing. If the scorer is unreachable, fall back to signal strength and say so in the receipt.

promote.note: When enabled (or --promote passed), research invokes crm-core's crm_intake.py directly so discovered companies land on the board without a human step. Capped per run so a bad batch is a small mess, not a big one. requireNycEstimate means a candidate with no NYC headcount OR roles estimate is emitted to CSV but not auto-promoted.

grok.note: Agent Tools API. The legacy search_parameters Live Search API was retired 2026-01-12 and returns 410. Run `python3 scripts/research_probe.py` to verify the live request shape before trusting a run.

geography.note: considerHq companies are kept only when the signal itself is NYC-specific (e.g. 'opening a New York office').

exclusions.note: Biotech/Therapeutics are hard-excluded per crm-core second-pass. Crypto terms are flagged in signal_notes, not dropped — the score agent owns that judgment.

dedup.note: Notion read is a courtesy pre-filter to cut noise. crm_intake.py remains the authority on dedup.
